Leave all changes uncommitted. Let the workflow commit the project source and push the result branch.

Before starting the server, confirm that a playable HTML entrypoint exists at `./index.html` or `./dist/index.html`; if neither exists, create or repair the required `index.html` and verify it before continuing. Generate `start.sh` in the project root. Make it work on a fresh Actions runner: change to its own directory, install required dependencies, build when required, and start the app on `${PORT:-3000}` in the foreground. Make repeated launches reuse dependencies safely. Add per-command timing. Keep tunnel setup in the workflow. Test the script from a stopped app with no installed project dependencies. Run it in the tmux session named app-server on port 3000, run browser tests, fix any failures, and confirm the app works on port 3000. After every fix or retry, re-check that `index.html` or `dist/index.html` exists and is the page the server actually serves. Capture final browser screenshots under `screenshots/` with filenames beginning with `final-`. Do not commit screenshots or runtime logs. The workflow will upload screenshots and logs to the run release, commit the project source, and publish the immutable project branch and completion update.
